summary: Iter 11: Verified Sony Bravia driver replacing Samsung + SmartThings removal + lock-screen QR. Backend: 10/10 pytest passed (auth gate still holds, config shape has psk/no token/no smartthings, PSK mask + preserve-on-echo works, SonyBravia log entries with correct notes for power WoL / volume / IRCC KEY_MUTE, /config/test/tv returns demo-mode ok:false). Frontend: PIN keypad unlock works, QR + caption shown on lock screen, Settings TV card titled 'Sony Bravia TVs', all four TVs expose tv-ip/mac/hdmi/psk fields when LIVE, settings-smartthings is absent, setup-guide-link present, all 5 bottom tabs load without console errors. Setup Wizard code confirmed via grep: wizard-tv-hdmi-* and wizard-tv-psk-* present and labeled 'Sony Bravia TVs'. WatchTab toast string 'Sony Bravia absolute level' confirmed in source. Teardown verified: tv.live=false, PSK cleared, no smartthings key in config.
critical_code_review_comments: SonyBraviaDriver.power(on=False) path doesn't send Wake-on-LAN (correct) but also runs setPowerStatus false; if TV already off this returns error upstream — acceptable for live scenarios.

server.py get_state mutates `_cfgm` locally but not the persisted doc; migration from legacy 'token'->'psk' is only in-memory per read. If an older doc has 'smartthings' it will be re-returned by future reads correctly since _cfgm is doc['config'] alias — OK.

No tests cover MAC validation in SonyBraviaDriver._wol; a malformed MAC in live mode would raise 'Invalid MAC address' and the whole /display/power would log status=error. Low priority for cloud demo.
seed_data_creation: None (PSK write test used TEST secret, cleaned up at end)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sony Bravia TV driver (replaces Samsung) + lock-screen QR are fully verified. SmartThings is cleanly removed from backend config and frontend Settings. All demo-mode invariants preserved so /auth/demo + pin-demo-bypass still function. For future iters re-run /app/backend/tests/test_iter11_sony.py as regression.
